displayName: Audit Event ASIM filtering parser for Prompt Shields AI activity
query:
let EventResultLookup = datatable(EventType_PS:string, EventResult_PS:string)
[
  'Blocked',     'Failure',
  'Redacted',    'Partial',
  'Anonymised',  'Partial',
  'Coached',     'Success',
  'BiasFlagged', 'Success'
];
let SeverityLookup = datatable(Severity_PS:string, EventSeverity_PS:string)
[
  'High',   'High',
  'Medium', 'Medium',
  'Low',    'Low'
];
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    actorusername_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    operation_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventresult: string = '*',
    object_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    newvalue_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    disabled: bool = false
) {
  PromptShieldsActivity_CL
  | where not(disabled)
  | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
      and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
  // Prompt Shields records no source IP, so any caller filtering on one is
  // asking for rows this source cannot produce. Returning nothing is correct;
  // ignoring the filter would hand back unrelated rows as though they matched.
  | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
  | where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or User has_any (actorusername_has_any)
  | where array_length(operation_has_any) == 0 or EventType has_any (operation_has_any)
  | where array_length(object_has_any) == 0 or AiTool has_any (object_has_any)
  // NewValue is never populated by this source; a caller filtering on it wants
  // change-tracking rows, which these are not.
  | where array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0
  | lookup EventResultLookup on $left.EventType == $right.EventType_PS
  | lookup SeverityLookup on $left.Severity == $right.Severity_PS
  | extend EventResult = coalesce(EventResult_PS, 'NA')
  | where eventresult == '*' or EventResult =~ eventresult
  // Every Prompt Shields event is a policy decision about an AI interaction,
  // not a CRUD operation on a stored object, so the ASIM EventType is 'Other'
  // for all of them and the specific decision lives in Operation. Mapping
  // Blocked to 'Delete' or Coached to 'Set' would put our events in ASIM
  // buckets whose meaning they do not share.
  | extend EventType = 'Other'
  | where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType has_any (eventtype_in)
  | extend
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventProduct = 'Prompt Shields',
      EventVendor = 'Prompt Shields',
      EventSchema = 'AuditEvent',
      EventSchemaVersion = '0.1.2',
      EventSeverity = coalesce(EventSeverity_PS, 'Informational'),
      EventUid = EventId,
      EventMessage = Detail,
      EventSubType = column_ifexists('SensitiveType', ''),
      ActorUsername = User,
      ActorUsernameType = 'UPN',
      ActorUserId = column_ifexists('UserAadObjectId', ''),
      ActorUserIdType = 'AADID',
      ActorScope = column_ifexists('Department', ''),
      DvcId = column_ifexists('EndpointId', ''),
      DvcIdType = 'Other',
      DvcOs = column_ifexists('EndpointPlatform', ''),
      TargetAppName = AiTool,
      TargetAppType = 'SaaS application'
  | extend
      // Operation carries the enforcement decision — this is the field an
      // analyst filters on to find blocked or redacted prompts.
      Operation = EventType_PS,
      // The object acted upon is the AI tool the prompt was headed for.
      Object = AiTool,
      ObjectType = 'Cloud Resource',
      Dvc = coalesce(DvcId, 'Prompt Shields')
  | project-away EventType_PS, EventResult_PS, Severity_PS, EventSeverity_PS
};
parser(
  starttime = starttime,
  endtime = endtime,
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix = srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
  actorusername_has_any = actorusername_has_any,
  operation_has_any = operation_has_any,
  eventtype_in = eventtype_in,
  eventresult = eventresult,
  object_has_any = object_has_any,
  newvalue_has_any = newvalue_has_any,
  disabled = disabled
)
